name: M.O.R.T.I.S.

features.text: Neutral native-zombie framework: type, trait, behavior, component and species registries; authoritative identity, persistence and reconciliation. Consumers own archetypes and gameplay policy.
Anatomy, trauma, tissue/decomposition transactions, detached-part provenance and attachment sockets, plus hunger, locomotion ownership, trips/piles, crowd flow and logical groups.
API 1.6.0 food-provider reservation, commit, compensation and quarantine. Nightfall supplies its own effigy adapter; native cross-resource durability remains unverified.
Client-only main-menu zombie definition creator: local drafts, validation, Lua preview/export and a reviewed offline export fixture. No live registration, spawning or server import.
Dormant explicit Active Hours locomotion diagnostic and isolated offline weighted, phase, life-choice and configuration/key experiments. No population controller or production options are installed.
Research archive and explicit death-provenance provider integrate with Knowledge & Wisdom. The selected 0.16.0 dependency refuses affected multiplayer storage; there is no bypass.

Production Active Hours solar/profile policy, authoritative localized settings, durable life choices and bounded population lifecycle, after native authority/restoration proof and ownership contracts.
Human native creator UI/storage, dependency/SP review and dedicated locomotion/lifecycle evidence; full animation/lunge restoration and affected dependency private MP persistence remain open.

limits: Source review only. G7 BLOCKED / NOT TESTED; stable G8 BLOCKED. Runtime testing requiring an open game is human-operated. Lua-only runtime; no Project Remnants integration. Standalone Active Hours remains maintained and yields when MORTIS is enabled. Digest follows the shared generator, including historical Contents/mods when present; another layout safely requires review. Nightfall audit has three open P1 state defects and a P2 readiness diagnostics gap; consumer acceptance requires fixes.
